verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs list several first-party APIs: a Warehouse Sync API under /developers/apis/http/, a platform Audiences API under /developers/apis/platform/, a real-time personalization API, and direct event ingestion. Together these suggest the product can be driven programmatically, but the pack holds mostly page titles with little detail on endpoints, auth or coverage of product operations. Missing for 10: detailed API reference content (endpoints, auth, scope of management operations), evidence that configuration and audience management can be fully automated via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
